title: Chemical Smell
text: Chemical Smell. The 20 oz. mug arrived with an unpleasant chemical smell inside. After repeated washings, I can still smell it, even though the smell is not as strong as when first arrived. I do not recommend this 20 oz. mug until the company can find a way to send these out with no chemical smell.
